prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Settings now shows the workspace’s credit history below the balance, newest first, with localized dates, activity names, signed amounts, and explicit refund labels in English and Korean. TypeScript and page lint checks passed.

@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+from datetime import datetime
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_member_sees_all_workspace_transactions_newest_first(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    reader = signup(client, email="reader@example.com")
+    workspace = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]
+    other = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=reader).json()[0]
+    path = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace['id']}/credits/history"
+    assert client.get(path, headers=owner).json() == []
+
+    charge = "generate_project_cover_image"
+    entries = [(2, "refund", 15), (1, charge, -15), (3, "daily_refill", 50)]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(workspace["id"]), user_id=UUID(other["owner_id"])))
+        for day, action, amount in entries:
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=UUID(workspace["id"]), user_id=UUID(workspace["owner_id"]),
+                timestamp=datetime(2026, 1, day), action_type=action, amount=amount,
+            ))
+        session.add(CreditTransaction(workspace_id=UUID(other["id"]), user_id=UUID(other["owner_id"]),
+                                      action_type=charge, amount=-15))
+        session.commit()
+
+    response = client.get(path, headers=reader)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == [
+        {"action": action, "amount": amount, "created_at": datetime(2026, 1, day).isoformat()}
+        for day, action, amount in sorted(entries, reverse=True)
+    ]
+
+
+def test_history_hides_workspace_from_nonmembers(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    outsider = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    workspace_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]["id"]
+    for target in (workspace_id, uuid4()):
+        response = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{target}/credits/history", headers=outsider)
+        assert response.status_code == 404

@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.core.errors import AppException
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import Character, CreditTransaction, Project, User, Workspace
+from app.services.billing import billing_service
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def writer_workspace(session):
+    return session.exec(
+        select(Workspace).join(User, User.id == Workspace.owner_id).where(User.email == "writer@example.com")
+    ).one()
+
+
+def assert_billing(balance, debits):
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = writer_workspace(session)
+        assert workspace.credits == balance
+        ledger = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.amount < 0)).all()
+        assert [(row.action_type, row.amount) for row in ledger] == debits
+        assert all(row.workspace_id == workspace.id and row.user_id == workspace.owner_id for row in ledger)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind,action,cost", [
+    ("cover", "generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+    ("sheet", "generate_character_sheet", 20),
+    ("workflow_cover", "generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+    ("workflow_sheet", "generate_character_sheet", 20),
+])
+def test_background_failure_then_success(client, kind, action, cost):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    project_id = project["id"]
+    payload = None
+    if kind.endswith("cover"):
+        path = f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cover"
+        if kind == "workflow_cover":
+            path = f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/art-style"
+            payload = {"art_style": "Ink"}
+        model, target, field = Project, project_id, "cover_image_status"
+    else:
+        character = client.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=headers, json={
+            "name": "Driver", "project_id": project_id,
+        }).json()
+        model, target, field = Character, character["id"], "sheet_status"
+        path = f"/api/v1/characters/{target}/generate"
+        if kind == "workflow_sheet":
+            path = f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/characters/casting/generate"
+            payload = {"character_id": target, "name": "Driver", "description": "Night shift", "style": "Ink"}
+
+    for fail in (True, False):
+        FakeGemini.fail = fail
+        response = client.post(path, headers=headers, json=payload)
+        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+        with Session(engine) as session:
+            assert getattr(session.get(model, target), field) == ("failed" if fail else "completed")
+        assert_billing(500 if fail else 500 - cost, [] if fail else [(action, -cost)])
+
+
+def test_sync_failure_then_success(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    for fail in (True, False):
+        FakeGemini.fail = fail
+        response = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=headers, json={"prompt": "A night bus"})
+        assert response.status_code == (500 if fail else 200), response.text
+        assert_billing(500 if fail else 488, [] if fail else [("generate_panel_image", -12)])
+
+
+def test_overlapping_work_cannot_overdraw(client):
+    signup(client)
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = writer_workspace(session)
+        workspace.credits = 15
+        session.commit()
+        charges = [billing_service.prepare_charge(session, workspace.id, workspace.owner_id,
+                                                  "generate_project_cover_image") for _ in range(2)]
+        charges[0].commit(session)
+        with pytest.raises(AppException) as error:
+            charges[1].commit(session)
+        assert error.value.status_code == 402
+    assert_billing(0, [("generate_project_cover_image", -15)])
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_and_regeneration(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    created = client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=headers, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "Ink wash"})
+    assert created.status_code == 200, created.text
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/styles", headers=headers).json()[0]["status"] == "failed"
+    assert_billing(500, [])
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/styles/{created.json()['id']}/regenerate", headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/styles", headers=headers).json()[0]["status"] == "completed"
+    assert_billing(490, [("style_sample_generation", -10)])
+
+
+def test_empty_style_fallback_is_free(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    response = client.post("/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", headers=headers, json={"description": "Ink"})
+    assert response.json() == {"options": []}
+    assert_billing(500, [])
+
+
+def test_insufficient_balance_blocks_generation(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        writer_workspace(session).credits = 0
+        session.commit()
+    response = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=headers, json={"prompt": "A night bus"})
+    assert response.status_code == 402
+    assert not FakeGemini.calls
+    assert_billing(0, [])
